selected_geometry.precision: Representative point inside the community-mapped Changwang Building at NUIST’s Nanjing campus. It identifies the host building, not the first-floor data-centre room footprint, an entrance or a surveyed parcel.
selected_geometry.identity_review: The September 18 university operator notice explicitly places the data-centre room on Changwang Building’s first floor. The official 2023 university event notice identifies Changwang at 219 Ningliu Road; the official service directory independently identifies the building in the central campus area (Zhongyuan). Native OSM way 1114839561 has the exact Chinese building name 长望楼. Every building vertex is inside outer way 93553391 of the university-named relation 13070911, rather than the separate southern Yuyuan component 1057168425. The 2024 building changeset also explicitly describes NUIST Zhongyuan. The contact office S103 and event hall N102 are not assigned as the data-centre room.
selected_geometry.uncertainty_reason: Community mapping provides no measured horizontal accuracy or verified first-floor room footprint. Decimal coordinate precision is not survey accuracy.

nuist.point_method: Decimal midpoint of native WGS84 vertex extrema, verified inside the named host-building polygon by ray casting. No GCJ/BD conversion, imagery tracing or georeferencing.
nuist.rights: OSM contributors / ODbL-1.0. University captures are retained only in ignored research files and are not redistributed.

selected_geometry.precision: Representative point inside Shaanxi Xueqian Normal University’s Chang’an campus at 101 Shenhe Second Road. It locates the named parent campus, not Jixue Building, room A102, an entrance or a surveyed parcel.
selected_geometry.identity_review: The original full procurement document identifies the data-centre room as Jixue Building A102. The official university campus-map page groups the illustration naming Jixue Building under Chang’an campus and separately identifies Yanta campus. Its footer gives Chang’an as 101 Shenhe Second Road. Native OSM way 246285562 exactly names Chang’an campus, with the same street and house number. This is a named campus/address bridge, not a university-name or road-intersection guess.
selected_geometry.uncertainty_reason: Community map geometry provides no measured positional accuracy. Displacement from this campus point to room A102 is unknown.
